title: In 1918, three Indiana brothers opened a bicycle shop; 108 years later, the same family still runs it
summary_full: Founded in 1918, a family-owned business in Indiana proudly celebrates over a century of service. Remarkably, it boasts a highly dedicated workforce, with several employees retiring after forty to fifty years. The company has successfully navigated industry shifts while staying true to its original operational methods, fostering strong customer loyalty and benefiting from the expertise of its long-serving employees.
